verdict.rationale: Consensus explicitly markets a 'Research Agent' that chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, and similar-papers lookups on top of its search engine, plus 'Deep Searches' for more comprehensive multi-study literature reviews — evidence of autonomous multi-step investigation beyond single-pass Q&A. However, the depth of autonomy (how many steps, how it plans, error-correction) is thin, mostly marketing copy without a hands-on trace of an actual multi-step run. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the agent executing a multi-step investigation autonomously, detail on planning/iteration logic, and evidence of how it decides when to stop or go deeper.
